functions.arguments: image jsonb, secret_columns text[], personal_columns text[], email_columns text[]
functions.body:
SELECT jsonb_object_agg(
    entry.key,
    CASE
      WHEN entry.value = 'null'::jsonb THEN entry.value
      WHEN entry.key = ANY (secret_columns) THEN to_jsonb('[REDACTED]'::text)
      WHEN entry.key = ANY (email_columns) AND position('@' IN (entry.value #>> '{}')) > 1
        THEN to_jsonb(left(entry.value #>> '{}', 1) || '***' || substring(entry.value #>> '{}' FROM '@[^@]*$'))
      WHEN entry.key = ANY (email_columns) OR entry.key = ANY (personal_columns) THEN to_jsonb('[PII]'::text)
      WHEN octet_length(entry.value::text) > 16384
        THEN jsonb_build_object('truncated', true, 'originalBytes', octet_length(entry.value::text))
      ELSE entry.value
    END
  )
  FROM jsonb_each(image) AS entry

functions.arguments: want_resource text, want_action text, org_id text, loc_id text
functions.body:
WITH member AS (
    SELECT m.id, m."roleId"
    FROM public."Membership" m
    WHERE app_current_user_id() IS NOT NULL
      AND (app_current_tenant_id() IS NULL OR app_current_tenant_id() = org_id)
      AND m."tenantId" = org_id
      AND m."userId" = app_current_user_id()
      AND m.status = 'ACTIVE'
      AND m."isDeleted" = false
  ),
  -- The membership's stores cover the record (a deleted store drops out of the scope).
  covered AS (
    SELECT 1 FROM member
    WHERE loc_id IS NULL
       OR EXISTS (
         SELECT 1 FROM public."MembershipLocationScope" s
         LEFT JOIN public."Location" l ON l.id = s."locationId"
         WHERE s."membershipId" = member.id
           AND s."isDeleted" = false
           AND (s."scopeType" = 'ALL_LOCATIONS' OR (s."locationId" = loc_id AND l."isDeleted" = false))
       )
  ),
  -- The exact verb asked for: there is no catch-all action (as `permissionSatisfies`).
  wanted AS (
    SELECT p.id FROM public."Permission" p
    WHERE p."isDeleted" = false
      AND p.scope NOT IN ('OWN', 'RESOURCE')
      AND p.resource::text = want_resource
      AND p.action::text = want_action
  )
  SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM covered) AND (
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM member
      JOIN public."Role" r ON r.id = member."roleId"
      JOIN public."RolePermission" rp ON rp."roleId" = r.id
      WHERE r."isDeleted" = false AND r."isActive" = true AND r.kind = 'TENANT' AND r."tenantId" = org_id
        AND rp."isDeleted" = false
        AND rp."permissionId" IN (SELECT id FROM wanted)
    )
    OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public."UserPermission" g
      LEFT JOIN public."Location" l ON l.id = g."locationId"
      WHERE g."userId" = app_current_user_id()
        AND g."tenantId" = org_id
        AND g.effect = 'ALLOW'
        AND g."isDeleted" = false
        AND (g."expiresAt" IS NULL OR g."expiresAt" > (EXTRACT(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint)
        AND g."permissionId" IN (SELECT id FROM wanted)
        -- A store-limited grant reaches only that store, never a tenant-level record.
        AND (g."locationId" IS NULL OR (g."locationId" = loc_id AND l."isDeleted" = false))
    )
  );
functions.comment: ADR 067: the caller's role or a live grant gives resource.action in the tenant, at the store (NULL: tenant-level).

functions.body:
SELECT app_current_user_id() IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public."ResourceAcl" a
    JOIN public."Membership" m ON m.id = a."membershipId"
    WHERE a."resourceType" = want_resource
      AND a."resourceId" = record_id
      AND a."isDeleted" = false
      AND (a."expiresAt" IS NULL OR a."expiresAt" > (EXTRACT(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint)
      AND (a.level::text = want_level OR a.level = 'EDIT')
      AND m."userId" = app_current_user_id()
      AND m.status = 'ACTIVE'
      AND m."isDeleted" = false
      AND (app_current_tenant_id() IS NULL OR app_current_tenant_id() = m."tenantId")
  );

BEGIN
  INSERT INTO public."DataChangeGroup" AS g ("groupKey", "firstChangeId", "firstChangeSequence", "transactionId", "correlationId", "occurredAt")
  SELECT COALESCE(c."correlationId", 'tx:' || c."transactionId"::text),
         (array_agg(c.id ORDER BY c."changeSequence"))[1],
         min(c."changeSequence"),
         (array_agg(c."transactionId" ORDER BY c."changeSequence"))[1],
         (array_agg(c."correlationId" ORDER BY c."changeSequence"))[1],
         min(c."occurredAt")
    FROM inserted AS c
   GROUP BY 1
  ON CONFLICT ("groupKey") DO UPDATE SET
    "firstChangeId" = CASE WHEN EXCLUDED."firstChangeSequence" < g."firstChangeSequence" THEN EXCLUDED."firstChangeId" ELSE g."firstChangeId" END,
    "transactionId" = CASE WHEN EXCLUDED."firstChangeSequence" < g."firstChangeSequence" THEN EXCLUDED."transactionId" ELSE g."transactionId" END,
    "firstChangeSequence" = LEAST(g."firstChangeSequence", EXCLUDED."firstChangeSequence"),
    "occurredAt" = LEAST(g."occurredAt", EXCLUDED."occurredAt"),
    "updatedAt" = (EXTRACT(epoch FROM clock_timestamp()) * 1000)::bigint
  WHERE EXCLUDED."firstChangeSequence" < g."firstChangeSequence" OR EXCLUDED."occurredAt" < g."occurredAt";
  RETURN NULL;
END
